mr_title: Use SelectionQuery/MutationQuery wherever possible in Panache + avoid warning HHH000104

expected_issues.title: Entity update runs on the default persistence unit
expected_issues.description:
executeUpdate(entityClass, ...) now runs the update through the default persistence unit session instead of the session of the entity's persistence unit, so Entity.update(...) fails or hits the wrong datasource for entities in a named persistence unit.

Every other entity-scoped operation uses getSession(entityClass), which resolves the persistence unit the entity belongs to. In the rewrite to createMutationQuery, the entity-based update was switched to getSession(DEFAULT_PERSISTENCE_UNIT_NAME). With multiple persistence units, `MyEntity.update("set x = ?1", v)` then targets the default database (unknown entity error, or writes to the wrong schema).
